ruling.recommended_action: Route to Ryde Trust & Safety for human review of the dangerous-driving allegation and the driver's abusive statement; no automatic refund or fee action on the fare ($24.76) pending review.
ruling.escalation_reason: Rider filed a safety incident alleging speeding, hard braking and overtaking on the shoulder during a RydeX trip NUS → Raffles Place (pickup 08:36, drop-off 08:52), saying she was scared and felt unsafe. The system trace gives no driving-behaviour evidence: distance and duration match the estimate (10.6 km vs 10.7 km optimal, 16.1 min vs 16 min) [F1][F2], and the chat holds only the pickup arrangement messages [F3][F4][F5], so the manner of driving cannot be corroborated or refuted from the record. Human review should also note the driver's post-trip statement calling the rider "stupid", which is abuse aimed at the other party under SAFE-1 [F6]. Check: any in-app or telematics/gyro-acceleration data, other rider/driver reports in the same time window [F8 profile shows no prior disputes], and whether the complaint was filed within the NS-7 30-day window. Report paths: 995 if medical assistance is needed, driver's commercial motor insurance for a medical claim, RydeHELP for the safety report [SAFE-2].
